advanced-filter-card-dates-hint: Hluza imihla yamakhadi usebenzisa @createdAt, @receivedAt, @startAt, @dueAt, @endAt okanye @listEnteredAt. Umzekelo: @endAt >= '2026-01-01' okanye @endAt = none. Faka igama lendawo eyenzelwe wena eqala ngo-@ phakathi kweempawu zocaphulo.
advanced-filter-description: Isihluzi esikwinqanaba eliphambili livumela ukubhala umtya oqulathe abaqhubi abalandelayo: == != <= >= && || () Isithuba sisetyenziswa njengomahluli phakathi kwabaSebenzisi. Unokuzihluza zonke iiNdawo eziSiko ngokuchwetheza amagama kunye namaxabiso azo. Umzekelo: Ummandla1 == Ixabiso1. Qaphela: Ukuba amasimi okanye amaxabiso aqulathe izithuba, kufuneka uwahlanganisele kucatshulo olunye. Umzekelo: 'Ummandla 1' == 'Ixabiso loku-1'. Ukufumana abasebenzi bolawulo olunye (' \/) ukuba batsibe, ungasebenzisa \. Umzekelo: Indawo1 == Ndim. Kwakhona unokudibanisa iimeko ezininzi. Umzekelo: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Ngokwesiqhelo bonke abasebenzi batolikwa ukusuka ekhohlo ukuya ekunene. Unokutshintsha iodolo ngokubeka izibiyeli. Umzekelo: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3). Kananjalo unokukhangela iindawo ezibhaliweyo usebenzisa i-regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i
text-contains-trigger-description: Iyahambelana xa kudalwa ikhadi, okanye isihloko okanye inkcazelo yalo itshintshiwe, umbhalo omtsha uqulethe oku (akukho mahluko phakathi konobumba abakhulu nabancinci).
imported-member-no-account: Ilungu elingenisiweyo — akukho akhawunti ihambelanayo okwangoku
import-board-instruction-kanboard: Ncamathelisa i-JSON ekhutshelwe ngaphandle ye-Kanboard: into ene-"columns" (okanye ii-tasks eziphethe i-column_name) kunye ne-array ye-"tasks" (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Ii-columns ziba zizintlu kwaye ii-tasks ziba ngamakhadi.
import-board-instruction-deck: Ncamathelisa i-JSON yebhodi ye-NextCloud Deck (ibhodi ene-"stacks", i-stack nganye iphethe "cards" zayo). Ii-stacks ziba zizintlu kwaye ii-cards ziba ngamakhadi.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Ncamathelisa i-JSON yeqoqo le-work-packages ye-OpenProject (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Ii-statuses ziba zizintlu kwaye ii-work packages ziba ngamakhadi.
import-board-instruction-issues: Ncamathelisa i-array ye-JSON ye-issues ye-__sourceName__ (__endpoint__). Ii-issues ziba ngamakhadi ahlelwe kwizintlu ezithi Open / Closed.
import-board-instruction-asana: Ncamathelisa i-JSON yokukhutshwa kwe-tasks ye-Asana ({ "data": [...] } evela kukukhutshwa kwe-Asana okanye GET /tasks). Ii-tasks zihlelwa ngokwamacandelo (memberships); ii-tasks ezigqityiweyo ziya ku-Done.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Ncamathelisa i-JSON yokukhutshwa koluhlu lwe-ZenKit ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Ii-stages ziba zizintlu kwaye ii-items ziba ngamakhadi.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Ncamathisela uluhlu lwemisebenzi lwe-markdown (indlela ezisetyenziswa zizixhobo ze-markdown-kanban ezifana ne-Obsidian Kanban): izihloko ze-"## Igama loluhlu", nezinto ze- "- [ ]"/"- [x]" ngezantsi. Izihloko ziba luluhlu, ezinto zibe amakhadi.
import-board-instruction-leo: Ncamathisela isakhiwo se-Leo (ifayile ye-.leo). Amacandelo akwinqanaba eliphezulu aba zizintlu, amacandelo angaphantsi kwawo ngokuthe ngqo aba ngamakhadi, ze umbhalo wecandelo ube yinkcazo yekhadi. Amacandelo akumanqanaba anzulu aba zizintlu zokukhangela. Amacandelo aphawuliweyo angeniswa njengagqityiweyo.
import-board-instruction-opml: Ncamathisela ulwandlalo lwe-OPML oluthunyelwe ngaphandle yi-Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq okanye ezinye iinkqubo zolwandlalo. Izinto ezikwinqanaba eliphezulu ziba zizintlu, eziphantsi kwazo ziba ngamakhadi anenqaku njengenkcazo, kwaye ezikumanqanaba anzulu ziba zizintlu zokuhlola. Izinto ezigqityiweyo zingeniswa njengezigqityiweyo.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Ncamathisela ifayile ye-Org mode ebhalwe yi-Emacs, Orgzly okanye Beorg. Izihloko ezikwinqanaba eliphezulu ziba zizintlu kwaye izihloko zenqanaba lesibini ziba ngamakhadi. TODO kunye DONE, izinto eziphambili, iithegi, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE kunye CLOSED ziyagcinwa, kwaye iibhokisi zokukhangela nezihloko ezinzulu ziba zizintlu zokuhlola.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Cola ifayile ye-todo.txt: umsebenzi omnye kumgca ngamnye, ngendlela i-app ye-todo.txt nee-app ezihambelanayo eziyibhala ngayo. Imisebenzi egqityiweyo ("x") iya kwicandelo eligqityiweyo, +project no-@context ziba ziilebhile, (A) iba yilebhile yokubaluleka, kanti due: no-t: ziba yimihla yokugqibela neyokuqala.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Ncamathisela isiphumo se-task export: uluhlu lwe-JSON okanye umsebenzi omnye kumgca ngamnye. Imisebenzi egqityiweyo iya ku-Done, i-project ne-priority ziba ziileyibhile, i-annotations iba ngamagqabantshintshi, kanti i-depends iba kukuxhomekeka kwimisebenzi ethintelayo.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Khupha ifayile ye-.boardarchive kwindawo ecinezelweyo uze uncamathisele umxholo we-board.jsonl yebhodi, kunye nomgca wenguqulelo okanye ngaphandle kwawo. Uphawu lokwahlula ngokwamaqela kumboniso webhodi luba zizintlu, ezinye iimpawu zokukhetha ziba ziileyibhile, iibhloko zombhalo neebhokisi zokukhangela ziba yinkcazelo noluhlu lokukhangela, aze amagqabantshintshi agcinwe. Imifanekiso nezincamatheliso azingeniswa.
import-board-instruction-todoist: Kwi-Todoist, vula imenyu yeprojekthi uze ukhethe Export as a template, emva koko uncamathisele ifayile ye-CSV. Amacandelo aba zizintlu, imisebenzi iba ngamakhadi, imisebenzi engaphantsi iba luluhlu lokuhlola, amanqaku aba zizimvo, kwaye @labels nezinto eziphambili p1 ukuya p3 ziba ziileyibhile.
import-board-instruction-planner: Kwi-Microsoft Planner, vula imenyu yesicwangciso uze ukhethe Export plan to Excel, emva koko ukhethe loo fayile ye-.xlsx. Amaqela aba zizintlu kwaye imisebenzi iba ngamakhadi, kunye nababelweyo, imihla, iileyibhile, uluhlu lokuhlola nenkcazo; Progress, Priority kunye Completed By ziba ziinkalo ezenzelwe wena.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: Kwi-MeisterTask, cofa igama leprojekthi, khetha Export project uze uthumele ngaphandle i-CSV, emva koko uyincamathisele. Amacandelo aba zizintlu kwaye imisebenzi iba ngamakhadi, kunye namanqaku, umhla wokugqibela, umntu owabelweyo neethegi; imisebenzi egqityiweyo igcina umhla wayo wokugqitywa. I-CSV ebhalelwe ukungenisa kwe-MeisterTask ngokwayo nayo iyasebenza.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: Kwi-Obsidian, vula ifayile yebhodi ye-Kanban njenge-Markdown (okanye uvule ifayile ye-.md kumhleli wombhalo), emva koko uncamathisele yonke. Iindlela ziba zizintlu kunye nemida yazo yamakhadi, amakhadi agcina iithegi, imihla, izinto eziphambili, iinkalo noluhlu lokuhlola, kwaye i-Archive iba ngamakhadi agcinwe kwindawo yogcino.
import-board-instruction-linear: Kwi-Linear, thumela imiba ngaphandle njenge-CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, okanye ukuthumela ngaphandle kumboniso), emva koko uncamathisele i-CSV. Iimeko ziba zizintlu, amaqela aba ziindlela zokuqubha, kwaye imiba iba ngamakhadi kunye nomntu owabelweyo, iileyibhile, imihla, umba ongumzali, into ephambili, uqikelelo, iprojekthi nomjikelo.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: Kwi-TickTick, vula Settings, Account, Backup & Import uze wenze ikopi yokugcina, emva koko uncamathisele ifayile ye-CSV. Uluhlu ngalunye lwe-TickTick luba yindlela yokuqubha kwaye iikholam zalo ziba zizintlu; imisebenzi igcina iithegi, imihla, uluhlu lokuhlola, izinto eziphambili nemisebenzi engaphantsi.
import-board-instruction-clickup: Kwi-ClickUp, thumela imisebenzi ngaphandle njenge-CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, okanye ukuthumela ngaphandle kumboniso we-List okanye we-Table nazo zonke iikholam), emva koko uncamathisele i-CSV. Iimeko ziba zizintlu, izintlu ze-ClickUp ziba ziindlela zokuqubha, kwaye imisebenzi iba ngamakhadi kunye nemisebenzi engaphantsi, ababelweyo, iithegi, imihla, izinto eziphambili nexesha.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: Kwi-Nullboard, vula ibhodi, khetha Export this board... kwimenyu, vula ifayile ye-.nbx kumhleli wombhalo uze uncamathisele okuqulethwe yiyo. Izintlu ziba zizintlu kwaye amanqaku aba ngamakhadi: umgca wokuqala wenqaku uba sisihloko sekhadi kwaye okuseleyo kuba yinkcazo yalo. Inqaku elikuhlobo lwe-raw lifumana ileyibhile ethi raw. Kwifayile eneebhodi ezininzi kungeniswa ibhodi yokuqala.
import-board-instruction-kanri: Kwi-Kanri, vula Import & Export uze ukhethe Export individual board (okanye Export all data), emva koko uncamathisele ifayile ye-.json. Iikholam ziba zizintlu kwaye amakhadi aba ngamakhadi, kunye nenkcazo, umhla wokugqibela, iithegi nemibala; imisebenzi yekhadi iba luluhlu lokuhlola. Ekuthunyelweni ngaphandle kwedatha yonke kungeniswa ibhodi yokuqala.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: Kwi-Pivotal Tracker, vula ithebhu ye-MORE yeprojekthi uze ukhethe Export CSV (okanye ukhethe amabali uze ukhethe Bulk Actions, CSV), emva koko uncamathisele i-CSV. Imeko nganye yebali iba luluhlu kwaye amabali aba ngamakhadi, kunye nohlobo neeleyibhile zawo, abanini, umceli, imihla, izimvo, imisebenzi nezithintelo; Estimate iba yi-Story points kwaye uphindaphindo luba zii-sprint.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: Kwi-Tasks.org, vula Settings, Backups uze ukhethe Export tasks, emva koko uncamathisele okuqulethwe yile fayile ye-.json. Izintlu ziba zizintlu kwaye imisebenzi iba ngamakhadi, kunye namanqaku, iithegi, imihla, izimvo nemisebenzi engaphantsi; imisebenzi egqityiweyo igcina umhla wayo wokugqitywa, kwaye into ephambili iba yinkalo eyenzelwe wena.
import-board-instruction-monday: Kwi-monday.com, vula imenyu yebhodi, khetha More actions kunye Export board to Excel (kunye nohlaziyo nezinto ezingaphantsi ukuba uyafuna), emva koko ukhethe loo fayile ye-.xlsx. Ikholam ye-Status iba zizintlu kwaye amaqela aba ziindlela zokuqubha; abantu, imihla, umgca wexesha neethegi zigcina iindawo zazo, ezinye iikholam ziba ziinkalo ezenzelwe wena kwaye uhlaziyo luba zizimvo.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: Kwi-Super Productivity, vula Settings, emva koko Sync & Backup, khetha Export Data uze uncamathisele okuqulethwe yifayile ye-sp-backup .json. Iprojekthi nganye iba yindlela yokuqubha kwaye imisebenzi iba ngamakhadi kwi-To Do, In Progress, Backlog okanye Done, kunye namanqaku, iithegi, umhla wokugqibela, ixesha elichithiweyo nemisebenzi engaphantsi; imisebenzi egcinwe kwindawo yogcino iba ngamakhadi agcinwe kwindawo yogcino.
import-board-instruction-taiga: Kwi-Taiga, vula Admin > Project > Export uze ukhuphele idatha yeprojekthi (qala ukhulule ifayile ye-.json.gz), emva koko uncamathisele i-JSON yayo. Iimeko zamabali abasebenzisi ziba zizintlu, amabali abasebenzisi aba ngamakhadi nemisebenzi yawo ibe yimisebenzi engaphantsi, ii-epic nemiba zifumana iindlela zokuqubha zazo, kwaye ii-sprint, iithegi, izimvo neempawu ezenzelwe wena nazo ziyangeniswa. Izincamathelisi azingeniswa.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: Kwi-Vikunja, vula Settings, khetha Data Export uze ukhuphele ifayile ye-.zip ethunyelwa kuwe, emva koko ukhethe loo fayile, okanye uncamathisele i-data.json engaphakathi kuyo. Amaqela e-Kanban aba zizintlu kwaye imisebenzi iba ngamakhadi, kunye neeleyibhile, ababelweyo, imihla, inkcazo, izintlu zemisebenzi njengezintlu zokuhlola nezimvo; into ephambili, ipesenti egqityiweyo nokugqitywa ziba ziinkalo ezenzelwe wena. Izincamathelisi azingeniswa.
import-board-instruction-quire: Kwi-Quire, vula imenyu yeprojekthi uze ukhethe Export CSV, emva koko uncamathisele i-CSV. Iimeko ziba zizintlu kwaye imisebenzi iba ngamakhadi, kunye nemisebenzi engaphantsi njengamakhadi angaphantsi, ababelweyo, iithegi njengeeleyibhile, imihla yokuqala, yokugqibela neyokugqitywa, inkcazo nento ephambili njengenkalo eyenzelwe wena. Izimvo nezincamathelisi azikho kwi-CSV ye-Quire.
import-board-instruction-wrike: Kwi-Wrike, thumela iprojekthi okanye isiqulathi seefayile ngaphandle kwi-Excel, okanye ugcwalise itemplate yokungenisa ye-Excel ye-Wrike, emva koko ukhethe loo fayile ye-.xlsx. Imiqolo yezisiqulathi zeefayile neeprojekthi iba ziindlela zokuqubha, Status iba zizintlu kwaye imisebenzi iba ngamakhadi, kunye ne-Key, umsebenzi ongumzali, ababelweyo, imihla yokuqala neyokuphela, izinto exhomekeke kuzo nenkcazo; Priority, Duration nezinye iikholam ziba ziinkalo ezenzelwe wena.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: Kwi-Teamwork.com, gcwalisa itemplate yokungenisa imisebenzi ye-Excel (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) uze uyigcine njenge-.xlsx, emva koko ukhethe loo fayile. Izintlu zemisebenzi ziba zizintlu kwaye imisebenzi iba ngamakhadi; umsebenzi oqala ngo -, # okanye > uba ngumsebenzi ongaphantsi komsebenzi ongasentla kwawo (--, ## okanye >> kwinqanaba elinye elinzulu). Ababelweyo, imihla neethegi zigcina iindawo zazo; Priority, Estimated time kunye Complete ziba ziinkalo ezenzelwe wena.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: Kwi-Businessmap (eyayisakuba yi-Kanbanize), vula Advanced Search, khetha Configure results ukukhetha iikholam, khuphela ifayile ye-Excel, emva koko ukhethe loo fayile ye-.xlsx. Iikholam zifundwa ngamagama azo esiNgesi (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): ukuba iakhawunti yakho isebenzisa olunye ulwimi, qala uthiye umqolo wezihloko ngesiNgesi. Column iba zizintlu kwaye Lane iba ziindlela zokuqubha; abanini, iithegi, umbala, imihla, izimvo namakhonkco abazali zigcina iindawo zazo, kwaye Priority, Size, Type nezinye iikholam ziba ziinkalo ezenzelwe wena.
import-board-instruction-redmine: Kwi-Redmine, vula Issues yeprojekthi, khetha Also available in: CSV emazantsi oluhlu, khetha iikholam (All columns, kunye Description) uze uthumele ngaphandle, emva koko uncamathisele i-CSV. I-Redmine ithiya iikholam ngolwimi lwakho, ngoko seta ulwimi lwakho lube sisiNgesi kwi-My account ngaphambi kokuthumela ngaphandle. Imeko nganye iba luluhlu kwaye imiba iba ngamakhadi, kunye nesilandeleli njengeleyibhile, umntu owabelweyo, umbhali, imihla, umsebenzi ongumzali nemiba enxulumeneyo; into ephambili, udidi, uhlobo ekujoliswe kulo, ixesha eliqikelelweyo, % Done neenkalo ezenzelwe wena ziba ziinkalo ezenzelwe wena.
import-board-instruction-notion: Kwi-Notion, vula uvimba wedatha njengephepha elipheleleyo, khetha ••• kunye Export, khetha Markdown & CSV, uze ukhethe ifayile ye-.zip ekhutshelwayo, okanye i-CSV enye yovimba wedatha engaphakathi kuyo, okanye uncamathisele loo CSV. Ikholam ebizwa Status iba zizintlu (xa ingekho, kusetyenziswa ikholam yokuqala ebonakala ilukhetho, kwaye ingxelo yokungenisa ichaza ukuba yeyiphi); imiqolo iba ngamakhadi kunye nesihloko, iithegi njengeeleyibhile, abantu njengamalungu, imihla, nombhalo wephepha njengenkcazo; ezinye iikholam ziba ziinkalo ezenzelwe wena. Ubudlelwane, imifanekiso nezincamathelisi azingeniswa.
import-board-instruction-plane: Kwi-Plane, vula Workspace Settings, khetha Exports, thumela iiprojekthi ngaphandle njenge-JSON, CSV okanye Excel uze ukhuphele ifayile ye-.zip, emva koko ukhethe loo fayile, okanye ifayile enye engaphakathi kuyo, okanye uncamathisele i-JSON okanye i-CSV. Iimeko ziba zizintlu, iiprojekthi ziba ziindlela zokuqubha, kwaye imiba iba ngamakhadi kunye nesazisi, umzali, ababelweyo, iileyibhile, imihla, amakhonkco nezimvo; into ephambili, uqikelelo, umjikelo nemodyuli ziba ziinkalo ezenzelwe wena. Ukuthumela ngaphandle kwe-Plane akunazo iinkcazo okanye izincamathelisi, ngoko azingeniswa.
import-board-instruction-trello: Kwibhodi yakho ye-Trello, yiya ku-'Menu', emva koko 'Ngakumbi', 'Shicilela kwaye uThunyele ngaphandle', 'Thumela ngaphandle i-JSON', kwaye ukhuphele isicatshulwa esinesiphumo.
import-board-instruction-csv: Ncamathelisa iComma Separated Values(CSV)/Tab yakho eyahluliweyo amaxabiso (TSV) .
import-board-instruction-jira: Ncamathelisa i-JSON evela kuphendlo lwe-issue lwe-Jira Cloud REST API (GET /rest/api/3/search/jql), okanye into elingana nayo { "issues": [...] }. Ii-statuses ze-Jira ziba zizintlu kwaye ii-issues ziba ngamakhadi. Ngokukhethayo faka i-array ye-"automationRules" ukungenisa imithetho.
import-board-instruction-excel: Khetha i-spreadsheet ye-.xlsx yohlobo lwe-WeKan (iikholam ezifanayo nezokukhutshwa kwe-Excel: Title, Description, Status/List, Members, Labels, imihla, iindawo zesiko). Umqolo wokuqala ngumbhalo-ntloko.
import-board-instruction-wekan: Kwibhodi yakho, yiya 'kwiMenu', emva koko 'Ibhodi ethumela ngaphandle', kwaye ukhuphele okubhaliweyo kwifayile ekhutshelweyo.
import-board-instruction-about-errors: Ukuba ufumana iimpazamo xa ungenisa ibhodi, ngamanye amaxesha ukungenisa elizweni kusasebenza, kwaye ibhodi ikwiphepha leeBhodi zonke.

csv-mapping-list-missing: Ifayile ayinayo ikholamu yoluhlu. Khetha enye apha ngasentla, okanye uchwetheze igama loluhlu olunye aza kufakwa kulo onke amakhadi.

I-.zip eyiyo ngokwayo ukuthunyelwa ngaphandle okukodwa (Vikunja, Notion, Plane, okanye WeKan enezincamatheliso) iba yibhodi enye. Xa iifayile zikhethwe apha, iqhosha lokungenisa lingenisa zona endaweni yommandla ongasentla.
import-one-board-per-project-hint: Umzila wokuqubha ngamnye obuya kwenziwa kukungenisa (iprojekthi, ifolda okanye uluhlu lwesixhobo) uba yibhodi yawo. Amakhadi angabazali nezinto ezixhomekeke kwezinye phakathi kwezi bhodi zidweliswa kwingxelo yokungenisa.
export-all-boards-hint: Zonke iibhodi onokuzithumela ngaphandle, kukhuphelo olunye: i-Excel njengencwadi enye enamaphepha anegama lebhodi nganye; ezinye iifomathi njenge-.zip enefayile yebhodi nganye.

import-csv-placeholder: Ncamathelisa idatha yakho esebenzayo ye-CSV/TSV apha

globalSearch-instructions-description: Uphendlo lungabandakanya abaqhubi ukucokisa uphendlo.  Abasebenzisi bachazwa ngokubhala igama lomsebenzisi kunye nexabiso elahlulwe yikholoni.  Umzekelo, iinkcukacha zomsebenzisi we- `list:Blocked` zinganciphisa uphendlo lwamakhadi aqulethwe kuluhlu olubizwa ngokuba *Ivaliwe*.  Ukuba ixabiso liqulathe izithuba okanye oonobumba abakhethekileyo kufuneka lifakwe kumanqaku okucaphula (umz. `__operator_list__:"To Review"`).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - ​​amakhadi afuneka ukuya kuthi ga *<n>* iintsuku ukususela ngoku.  `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ udwelisa onke amakhadi adlulileyo kumhla wawo.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - ​​amakhadi aye alungiswa *<n>* kwiintsuku ezidlulileyo okanye ngaphantsi
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - ​​apho *<field>* yenye ye `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` okanye `__predicate_member__`.  Ukubeka i-`-` phambi kwe *<field>* kukhangelwa ukungabikho kwexabiso kuloo ndawo (umz. `has:-due` ukhangela amakhadi ngaphandle komhla omiselweyo).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - ​​apho *<sort-name>* yenye ye `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` okanye `__predicate_modified__`.  Kuhlobo oluhlayo, beka i-`-` phambi kohlobo lwegama.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - ​​apho *<n>* iyinani elipheleleyo elibonisa inani lamakhadi aza kuboniswa kwiphepha ngalinye.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Abasebenzisi abafanayo bafakwe *OKANYE* kunye.  Amakhadi ahambelana nayo nayiphi na imiqathango aya kubuyiselwa.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` angabuyisela amakhadi aqulethwe kulo naluphi na uluhlu olunegama elithi *Ovaliweyo* okanye *Iyafumaneka*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Abasebenzisi abohlukeneyo ba *AND*ed kunye.  Kuphela ngamakhadi afana nabo bonke abasebenzi abahlukeneyo abuyiselwayo.  `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` ubuyisela amakhadi kuphela kuluhlu *Iyafumaneka* enombhalo *obomvu*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Iintsuku zinokuchazwa njengenani elichanekileyo okanye elichasayo okanye kusetyenziswa `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` okanye `__predicate_year__` okwangoku.

recovery-report-desc: Izenzo ezizenzekelayo zokhuseleko nokulungisa idatha: ukufumanisa umonakalo, ukugcinwa kwedatha yombhalo, ukubuyisela, ukufuduka kwakhona kwi-MongoDB, kunye nokulungiswa okuzenzekelayo kwesiseko sedatha esidumbileyo.
recovery-no-events: Akukho ziganeko zokubuyisela zibhaliweyo. Isiseko sedatha siphilile.
recovery-maintenance-note: Nceda ulinde — eli phepha liya kuqhubeka ngokuzenzekelayo xa ukubuyisela kugqityiwe.

move-all-attachments-of-board-to-fs: Hambisa zonke izincamatheliso zebhodi kwindlela yefayile
move-attachments-none-found: Akukho nto igcinwe kwisitoreji somthombo esikhethiweyo, ngoko akukho nto yokuhambisa.
attachment-repair-locations-description: Fumana iziqhoboshelo nee-avatars apho isitoreji esibhaliweyo (filesystem / GridFS / cloud) singasahambelani nalapho ifayile ikhoyo, kwaye ulungise i-database ukuze ikhombe kwindawo yokwenene.
default-save-storage-description: Khetha isitoreji apho iziqhoboshelo ezisandula ukulayishwa zigcinwa khona.
mongodb-compact-description: Emva kokuhambisa iifayile ukuphuma kwi-MongoDB GridFS, ifayile ye-database ekwidiski ayinciphi ngokuzenzekelayo. Ukuqhuba i-Compact kubuyisela isithuba esikhululekileyo ngokuphinda kubhalwe idatha yeqokelelo. Yiqhube oku kuphela emva kokuba ukuhanjiswa kweefayile ezininzi kugqityiwe.
mongodb-compact-warning: Isilumkiso: I-Compact ngumsebenzi othintelayo onokuthatha imizuzu embalwa kwii-database ezinkulu. Kwii-replica sets, zonke ii-secondaries zicutywa kuqala (ngokuzenzekelayo), emva koko i-primary. Kwii-replica sets ze-node enye ezisetyenziselwa i-oplog (useto oluqhelekileyo lwe-Meteor), yi-primary kuphela ecutywayo.
mongodb-compact-running: Kuqhutywa i-compact, oku kunokuthatha imizuzu embalwa...
board-status-remaining-time-total: Ixesha eliseleyo ukuya kufikelela kumhla wokugqibela
invalid-file: Ukuba igama lefayile alisebenzi, ukulayisha okanye ukuthiya ngokutsha kuyarhoxiswa.
preview-pdf-not-supported: Isixhobo sakho asikuxhasi ukujonga kwangaphambili iPDF. Zama ukukhuphela endaweni yoko.
drag-board-to-workspace: Tsala ibhodi ukuya ku- __workspaces__ (yilahla indawo yokusebenza kwibar esecaleni)
delete-translation-confirm-popup: Ngaba uqinisekile ukuba ufuna ukucima lo mtya wenguqulelo yesiko? Akukho kuguqulwa.
import-board-zip: Yongeza ifayile ye-zip enebhodi ye-JSON iifayile, kunye nebhodi yamagama angaphantsi kwabalawuli abanezihlomelo
accounts-lockout-info: Ezi setingi zilawula ukuba iinzame zokungena zikhuselwa njani kuhlaselo olungenalusini.
accounts-lockout-known-users: Iisetingi zabasebenzisi abaziwayo (igama lomsebenzisi elichanekileyo, igama lokugqitha elingalunganga)
accounts-lockout-locked-users-info: Abasebenzisi batshixelwe ngaphandle ngenxa yeenzame ezininzi ezingaphumelelanga zokungena
accounts-lockout-confirm-unlock-all: Uqinisekile ukuba ufuna ukuvula bonke abasebenzisi abatshixiweyo?
attachments-path-description: Indlela apho iifayile ezincamathelayo zigcinwa khona
avatars-path-description: Indlela apho iifayile ze-avatar zigcinwa khona
cron-job-delete-confirm: Uqinisekile ufuna ukucima lo msebenzi ucwangcisiweyo?
s3-minio-storage-description: Isitoreji sezinto esihambelana ne-S3: AWS S3, MinIO, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, Wasabi, DigitalOcean Spaces nezinye.
s3-force-path-style-description: Ifunwa yi-MinIO kunye neeseva ezininzi ezingezizo ze-AWS ezihambelana ne-S3.
azure-connection-string-description: Ngokukhethayo: sebenzisa umtya woqhagamshelo opheleleyo endaweni yegama le-akhawunti kunye nesitshixo.
database-migration-description: Fudusela idatha esekelwe kumbhalo (yonke into ngaphandle kweziqhoboshelo nee-avatars, ezihlala kwi-filesystem) phakathi kwe-MongoDB kunye ne-FerretDB v1 (SQLite). Enye i-database kufuneka isebenze kwaye ifikeleleke (ii-ports ezimiselweyo: FerretDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018, MongoDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27019; bhangisa nge-WEKAN_FERRETDB_URL / WEKAN_MONGODB_URL). Emva kokuba igqibile, khomba i-MONGO_URL kwenye i-database uze uqale kwakhona i-WeKan (kwi-Snap: snap set wekan database=ferretdb okanye =mongodb).
database-migration-confirm: Khuphela zonke iiqokelelo ezisekelwe kumbhalo ku-__db__? Iziqhoboshelo nee-avatars kwi-filesystem azichaphazeleki. I-database ekujoliswe kuyo kufuneka isebenza.
sandstorm-migration-description: Xa i-WeKan isebenza ngaphakathi kwe-Sandstorm grain, i-database yayo endala ye-MongoDB 3 ifuduselwa ku-FerretDB v1 (SQLite) ekuqaleni kokuqala, kwaye iziqhoboshelo nee-avatars zihanjiswa ukusuka kwi-database ukuya kwii-directories ze-files/attachments kunye ne-files/avatars ze-grain. Oku kubonisa ukuba ukufuduka kuphumelele na kwaye ingakanani isithuba sediski iifayile ezikrwada ze-database ye-MongoDB endala ezisasisebenzisayo ngaphakathi kwe-grain, kwaye kukuvumela ukuba ucime ezo fayile zikrwada ukukhulula isithuba.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-description: Emva kokufuduka okuphumeleleyo idatha ihlala kwi-FerretDB nakwi-filesystem, ngoko iifayile ezikrwada ezindala ze-database ye-MongoDB 3 zinokucinywa ukukhulula isithuba sediski ye-grain. Oku akunakuguqulwa.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-confirm: Cima iifayile ezikrwada ze-database ye-MongoDB 3 ukukhulula isithuba sediski? Idatha sele ifuduselwe ku-FerretDB nakwi-filesystem. Oku akunakuguqulwa.
sandstorm-raw-mongodb-deleted: Iifayile ze-database ekrwada ye-MongoDB zicinyiwe, kukhululwe
features-desc: Iimpawu ozikhethayo ezinikezelwa yile WeKan. Uphawu olungaphawulwanga luyafihlwa kujongano lomntu wonke. Idatha yalo iyagcinwa kwaye iimvume azitshintshi.
feature-views-overview-desc: Iinkcukacha-manani, ukudibanisa ngokomntu owabelweyo, isicwangciso sendlela, ideshibhodi nebhodi enkulu.
feature-views-scrum-desc: Uluhlu lomsebenzi wemveliso, amaxesha amafutshane omsebenzi, ingxelo yexesha lomsebenzi nesantya.
feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Umsebenzi oseleyo nogqityiweyo, ukuhamba okuqokelelweyo, ixesha lomjikelo nelokuhambisa, ubungakanani bomsebenzi ogqityiweyo, ubudala bomsebenzi, izithintelo, i-Monte Carlo nezinye iimilinganiselo zokuhamba komsebenzi.
feature-approval-required: Gcina iimpawu ezongezwa luhlaziyo lwe-WeKan zivaliwe de umlawuli azivule
feature-preview-admins: Abalawuli babona iimpawu ezivaliweyo ukuze bazizame kuqala
card-field-visibility-desc: Iinkalo zeesetingi zebhodi / ikhadi ezinokuboniswa ziibhodi. Inkalo engaphawulwanga ifihlwa kuwo onke amakhadi, amakhadi amancinci nakwiisetingi zebhodi / ikhadi zazo zonke iibhodi. Akukho datha yekhadi okanye isetingi yebhodi etshintshayo, yaye ukuyiphawula kwakhona kubonisa ibhodi nganye njengoko yayimisiwe. Ulandelelwano lweenkalo lolwebhodi nganye.
cards-loading-description: Indlela ibhodi nganye elayisha ngayo amakhadi ayo. Onke amakhadi: ikhadi ngalinye lilayishwa kwibrawza (elula, zonke iimpawu ziyasebenza, kodwa ibhodi enamawaka amakhadi ithumela idatha eninzi kumbukeli ngamnye). I-Lazy: uluhlu ngalunye lulayisha kuphela amakhadi abonakalayo ngoku (i-scroll engenasiphelo) kunye nenani eliphilayo, ngoko iibhodi ezinkulu kakhulu zisebenzisa imemori ne-bandwidth encinci. Kwakhona imiselwa yi-CARDS_LOADING environment variable.
cards-loading-lazy-note: Ukulayisha ikhadi nge-Lazy kusekuvavanyweni: iikhawunta zamakhadi kunye nemida ye-WIP zichanekile, kodwa imiboniso ye-Calendar/Table/Gantt kunye nokukhetha okuninzi kubonisa kuphela amakhadi alayishiweyo kuza kuthi ga ngoku. Layisha kwakhona iibhodi ezivuliweyo emva kokutshintsha oku.
render-links-as-plain-text-description: Xa kuvuliwe, onke amakhonkco (womabini amakhonkco e-markdown afana ne-[label](url) kunye nee-tags ezikrwada ze-HTML <a href>) ahlala eboniswa njengombhalo ocacileyo, ongacofekiyo kuyo yonke intsimi yombhalo otyebileyo (izihloko zebhodi nekhadi, iinkcazo, izimvo, uluhlu lokukhangela, njl.). Oku kuthintela amakhonkco acofekayo alahlekisayo. Okumiselweyo kucimile, ngoko amakhonkco ahlala ecofeka.
always-show-code-as-text: Soloko ubonisa yonke ikhowudi njengombhalo ocacileyo
always-show-code-as-text-description: Xa kuvuliwe, umbhalo otyebileyo awuze uboniswe njenge-markdown okanye i-HTML: umthombo wonke uhlala uboniswa njengombhalo ocacileyo kuyo yonke intsimi yombhalo otyebileyo (izihloko zebhodi nekhadi, iinkcazo, izimvo, uluhlu lokukhangela, njl.). Oku kubonisa umxholo ofihliweyo — izimvo ze-HTML (<!-- -->), ekujoliswe kuko kwamakhonkco e-markdown, i-JavaScript nayo nayiphi na enye ikhowudi — ngoko yonke ikhowudi ihlala ibonakala, ingacofeki, kwaye ingasebenzi. Okumiselweyo kucimile, ngoko i-markdown iboniswa ngesiqhelo.
disable-all-import-description: Xa kuvuliwe, zonke iimpawu zokungenisa zicinywa: ukungenisa ibhodi evela kwi-WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea kunye ne-Forgejo, kunye nokwenza ikhophi yebhodi. Ukhetho lwemenyu yokungenisa lufihliwe kwaye iseva iyasala nasiphi na isicelo sokungenisa. Okumiselweyo kucimile.
disable-all-export-description: Xa kuvuliwe, zonke iimpawu zokuthumela ngaphandle zicinywa: ukuthumela ibhodi njenge-WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, okanye ku-NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, kunye nokuthumela isiqhoboshelo esinye. Ukhetho lwemenyu yokuthumela ngaphandle lufihliwe kwaye iseva iyasala nasiphi na isicelo sokuthumela ngaphandle. Okumiselweyo kucimile.
disable-import-avatars-description: Xa kuvuliwe, ii-avatars (imifanekiso yeprofayile yomsebenzisi) azize zingeniswe. Oku kubandakanya ukungenisa kwe-WeKan JSON, ukungenisa kwe-Trello, kunye nokuvumelanisa kwe-avatar ukusuka kubaboneleli bezazisi bangaphandle xa ungena (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). Amagama nenye idatha isengeniswa; kuphela ii-avatars ezitsityelwayo. Okumiselweyo kucimile.
disable-export-avatars-description: Xa kuvuliwe, ii-avatars (imifanekiso yeprofayile yomsebenzisi) azize zibandakanywe xa kukhutshwa ibhodi (ukukhutshwa kwe-WeKan JSON kunye ne-CSV). Amagama omsebenzisi nenye idatha isakhutshwa; kuphela ii-avatars ezishiywayo. Okumiselweyo kucimile.
anonymize-import-users-description: Xa kuvuliwe, ukungenisa ibhodi ye-WeKan JSON kutshintsha igama lomsebenzisi ngamnye ongenisiweyo, igama elipheleleyo neeleta zokuqala ngeziphathi-ndawo zekhawunta (user1, user2, ...), kususe i-avatar yabo, kwaye kubhale kwakhona ukukhankanywa kwe-@username (kunye neentsimi ze-requested-by / assigned-by) ngaphakathi komxholo wekhadi nezimvo ezingenisiweyo. Akukho sazisi somsebenzisi sokwenene esivela kwibhodi yomthombo esigcinwayo. Igama elithi "user" lilandela ulwimi lomntu ongenisayo. Okumiselweyo kucimile.
anonymize-export-users-description: Xa kuvuliwe, ukukhupha ibhodi kutshintsha igama lomsebenzisi ngamnye okhutshiweyo, igama elipheleleyo neeleta zokuqala ngeziphathi-ndawo zekhawunta (user1, user2, ...), kususe i-avatar yabo, kwaye kubhale kwakhona ukukhankanywa kwe-@username (kunye neentsimi ze-requested-by / assigned-by) ngaphakathi komxholo wekhadi nezimvo. Ifayile ekhutshiweyo ayinaso isazisi somsebenzisi sokwenene. Igama elithi "user" lilandela ulwimi lomntu okhuphayo. Okumiselweyo kucimile.
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: Xa kuvuliwe, ukukhupha ibhodi kutshintsha igama lomsebenzisi ngamnye okhutshiweyo, igama elipheleleyo neeleta zokuqala ngeziphathi-ndawo zekhawunta (user1, user2, ...), kususe i-avatar yabo, kwaye kubhale kwakhona ukukhankanywa kwe-@username (kunye neentsimi ze-requested-by / assigned-by) ngaphakathi komxholo wekhadi nezimvo. Ifayile ekhutshiweyo ayinaso isazisi somsebenzisi sokwenene. Igama elithi "user" lilandela ulwimi lomntu okhuphayo. Okumiselweyo kucimile.
disable-activities-description: Xa kuvuliwe, amangeno e-activity-feed azize arekhodwe kwaye azize aboniswe naphi na (ibar esecaleni yebhodi kunye ne-tab yomsebenzi wekhadi). Akukho mbali igcinwayo yokuba ngubani owenze ntoni. Okumiselweyo kucimile.
disable-notifications-description: Xa kuvuliwe, i-WeKan ayize ithumele izaziso zokubukela (ngaphakathi kwe-app, i-imeyile okanye ezinye iinkonzo) nawuphi na umsebenzi. Imisebenzi isenokurekhodwa (ngaphandle kokuba nayo icinyiwe ngentla); kuphela izaziso ezicinywayo. Okumiselweyo kucimile.
disable-watch-description: Xa kuvuliwe, uphawu lokubukela luyacinywa — abasebenzisi abakwazi ukubhalisa kwiibhodi, izintlu okanye amakhadi ukufumana izaziso, kwaye nawuphi na umzamo wokutshintsha inqanaba lokubukela uyaliwa. Okumiselweyo kucimile.
backup-description: Gcina iZiqhoboshelo, ii-Avatars kunye/okanye iDatha (zonke iiqokelelo ezisekelwe kumbhalo ezingezizo iziqhoboshelo okanye ii-avatars). I-.zip ithunyelwa ngokuthe ngqo kwisitoreji esikhethiweyo — akukho fayile yethutyana — njenge-backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, equlethe i-YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars kunye ne-/data. Izitoreji ze-cloud (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) zisebenzisa iziqinisekiso ezicwangcisiweyo kwii-tabs zazo zesitoreji.
backup-scope-description: Yonke iseva, okanye umbutho omnye. Ugcino lokhuselo lombutho luqulethe iibhodi zawo nayo yonke into ekuzo, kubandakanya neziqhoboshelo zezo bhodi — kodwa akukho iiakhawunti zabasebenzisi neesetingi zeseva, kuba ezo zabelwana ngazo yiyo yonke imibutho. Ukubuyisela ugcino lombutho kubhala kuphela kwiibhodi ezingezo zaloo mbutho.
continuous-backup-description: Luthumela lonke utshintsho kwisiseko sedatha, kwiziqhoboshelo, kwimifanekiso yabasebenzisi nakwiirekhodi kwifolda kwimizuzwana embalwa, ukuze kubuyiselwe imeko yalo naliphi na ixesha. Lusebenza kunye nogcino lokhuselo olucwangcisiweyo olwenza oovimba abapheleleyo.
continuous-backup-enabled: Sebenzisa ugcino lokhuselo oluqhubekayo kule seva
continuous-backup-target: Ifolda ekujoliswe kuyo (indlela epheleleyo kwenye idiski, kwindawo ekwabelwana ngayo kuthungelwano okanye kwindawo eqhagamshelwe nge-rclone)
continuous-backup-engine-none: Akukho njini yesiseko sedatha inokusebenza kule seva
continuous-backup-key-file: Ifayile yesitshixo sokufihla ngekhowudi (indlela epheleleyo ngaphandle kwefolda ekujoliswe kuyo; oonobumba abangama-64 benkqubo yamanani esekelwe kwi-16 okanye ibinzana eliyimfihlo elinoonobumba abali-16 ubuncinane). Gcina ikopi: ngaphandle kwayo ugcino lokhuselo alunakubuyiselwa.
continuous-backup-restore-sqlite: Ifayile yesiseko sedatha se-SQLite (yenziwa ecaleni kogcino lokhuselo, ayikhe ibhale ngaphezulu kwefayile esetyenziswayo)
continuous-backup-apply-on-restart: Sebenzisa isiseko sedatha se-SQLite esakhiwe ngokutsha ekuqaliseni kwakhona okulandelayo (isiseko sedatha esidala esithatyathelwe indawo siya kugcinwa)
continuous-backup-restore-confirm: Buyisela isizukulwana esikhethiweyo kwimeko yexesha elikhethiweyo? Ugcino lokhuselo oluqhubekayo luya kunqumama okwethutyana ngexesha lokubuyisela.
backup-restore-confirm: Buyisela ugcino olukhethiweyo? Iziqhoboshelo/ii-avatars zibhalwa kwi-filesystem kwaye idatha kwi-database ngokwemowudi ekhethiweyo.
gcs-key-filename-description: Ngokukhethayo: indlela eya kwifayile yesitshixo ye-JSON ye-akhawunti yenkonzo kwiseva.
gcs-credentials-description: Ngokukhethayo: ncamathelisa isitshixo se-JSON se-akhawunti yenkonzo. Yishiye ingenanto ukuze usebenzise ifayile yesitshixo okanye iziqinisekiso ezimiselweyo.
gcs-permissions-note: Nika i-akhawunti yenkonzo ye-WeKan ufikelelo lokufunda/lokubhala kwi-bucket: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → i-bucket yakho → Permissions → Grant access. Ku-"New principals", ncamathelisa i-imeyile ye-akhawunti yenkonzo — ixabiso le-"client_email" elivela kwisitshixo sakho se-JSON — emva koko khetha indima "Storage Object Admin" uze uGcine.
cloud-secret-keep-blank: Yishiye ingenanto ukuze ugcine ixabiso langoku.
gcs-bucket-description: Igama le-bucket ye-Cloud Storage yokugcina iifayile.
s3-endpoint-menu-path: AWS: yishiye ingenanto (isebenzisa i-endpoint yommandla). Ehambelana ne-S3: i-Endpoint URL evela kwi-console yakho ye-MinIO / Cloudflare R2 / Backblaze B2 / Wasabi / DigitalOcean Spaces.
s3-region-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → i-bucket yakho → Properties → AWS Region.
s3-bucket-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → igama le-bucket yakho (okanye Create bucket → Bucket name).
s3-access-key-menu-path: AWS Console → IAM → Users → umsebenzisi wakho → Security credentials → Access keys → Create access key → khetha imeko yokusetyenziswa 'Application running outside AWS' → Create access key. Iboniswa njenge 'Access key ID'.
s3-secret-key-menu-path: Isikrini esifanayo ne-Access key ID; i-'Secret access key' iboniswa kanye kuphela xa isitshixo senziwa — yikhuphele ngoko (okanye Download .csv).
azure-account-name-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → i-akhawunti yakho → igama eliboniswe phezulu (kwakhona phantsi kwe-Security + networking → Access keys → Storage account name).
azure-account-key-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → i-akhawunti yakho → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Show → Key.
azure-connection-string-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → i-akhawunti yakho → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Connection string → Show.
azure-container-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → i-akhawunti yakho → Data storage → Containers → isikhongozeli sakho (okanye + Container ukwenza esinye).
gcs-project-id-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → isikhetho seprojekthi phezulu → i-ID yeprojekthi yakho (Cloud overview → Dashboard → Project info → Project ID).
gcs-bucket-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → igama le-bucket yakho (okanye Create ukwenza esinye).
gcs-key-filename-menu-path: Indlela kwiseva ye-WeKan eya kwifayile yesitshixo ye-JSON ye-akhawunti yenkonzo ekhutshelweyo (eyenziwe ngezantsi). Sebenzisa oku OKANYE ncamathelisa i-JSON kwintsimi engezantsi.
gcs-credentials-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → IAM & Admin → Service accounts → i-akhawunti yakho yenkonzo → Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON → Create (ikhuphela ifayile). Ncamathelisa okuqulethwe kuyo apha, okanye gcina ifayile uze umisele indlela yayo ngentla.
migration-stop-confirm: Uqinisekile ukuba ufuna ukumisa konke ukufuduka?
gridfs-move-collectionfs-note: Ukuze iziqhoboshelo nee-avatars zibonakale, zihambise ukusuka kwi-CollectionFS uya kuso nasiphi na esinye isitoreji.
s3-enabled-description: Sebenzisa i-AWS S3 okanye iMiniO yokugcina ifayile
s3-endpoint-description: S3 endpoint URL (umzekelo, s3.amazonaws.com okanye minio.example.com)

scrum-partial-report: Ingxelo engaphelelanga: kufakwe kuphela amakhadi owabelweyo ngoku.
scrum-partial-snapshot: Le sprint iqulethe kuphela inxalenye yomfanekiso wokuqala ogciniweyo.
scrum-rollover-progress: Kuhanjiswa amakhadi e-sprint ukuya phambili: __done__ kwangama-__total__
scrum-history-job-running: Kurhoxiswa okanye kwenziwa kwakhona utshintsho olukhulu: __done__ kwimigca yembali engama-__total__
scrum-history-job-failed: Ukurhoxisa okanye ukwenza kwakhona utshintsho olukhulu kumile. Cofa kwakhona ku-rhoxisa okanye ku-yenza kwakhona ukuze uqhubeke:
scrum-daily-observations-help: Ibha nganye ibonisa okuqatshelwe kuqala kwaza kwarekhodwa ngosuku lwe-UTC, ngexesha elibonisiweyo. Iintsuku ezingekhoyo azifakwa. Oku kuqatshelweyo akurekhodi lonke utshintsho okanye kubonise amanani okuphela kosuku. Uqikelelo olungaziwayo alunguziro. Sebenzisa isenzo sokuthumela ngaphandle seli candelo ukufumana okuqatshelwe yonke imihla; isenzo sokuthumela ngaphandle kwibha yezixhobo sithumela iziphumo ze-sprint.
scrum-daily-truncated: Kuboniswa kuphela okuqatshelweyo kwamva nje okungu-366.
scrum-daily-empty: Akukho kuqatshelweyo kwemihla ngemihla kurekhodiweyo kule sprint.
scrum-scope-history: Ubungakanani bomsebenzi nomsebenzi oseleyo, utshintsho ngalunye
scrum-scope-history-help: Kwakhiwe ngokutsha kwimbali yebhodi ukususela ekuqaleni kwexesha lomsebenzi: umqolo omnye wotshintsho ngalunye kumakhadi exesha lomsebenzi, kuqikelelo okanye kumsebenzi ogqityiweyo.
scrum-scope-history-inconsistent: Imbali ayiphindi ivelise umfanekiso wemeko yeli xesha lomsebenzi ngokwalo: olunye utshintsho lwenziwa lungabhalwanga kwimbali, ngoko la maxabiso akaphelelanga.
scrum-scope-history-truncated: Kufundeke kuphela utshintsho lokuqala; ukwakhiwa ngokutsha akuphelelanga.
scrum-scope-history-empty: Akukho tshintsho ukususela ekuqaleni kwexesha lomsebenzi.
scrum-scope-cause-lifecycle: Ikhadi ligcinwe kwindawo yogcino okanye libuyiselwe
scrum-daily-observations-export-help: Okuqatshelwe kuqala kwaza kwarekhodwa ngosuku ngalunye lwe-UTC; iintsuku ezingekhoyo azifakwa. Okuqatshelweyo akurekhodi lonke utshintsho okanye amanani okuphela kosuku. Uqikelelo olungaziwayo alunguziro.
scrum-import-pending: Ukungeniswa kwe-Scrum akugqitywanga. Ukuhlelwa kwe-Scrum nokuthunyelwa kweengxelo ngaphandle akufumaneki.
scrum-import-recovery-hint: Ukungenisa okuphazanyiswe kukuqala ngokutsha kungagqityezelwa apha emva kokuba kumile. Ukuba isicwangciso sako asizange sigcinwe siphelele, kunokurhoxiswa kuphela; oku akutshintshi nto ebhodini.
scrum-import-into-board-hint: Khetha ifayile yebhodi ekhutshwe kwi-WeKan okanye ifayile yokudlulisa i-Scrum. Ii-sprint nokukhutshwa esele kukho kule bhodi kuyaqhagamshelwa, akuphindwa. Amakhadi athelekiswa nge-ID, okanye ngenombolo yekhadi nesihloko; amakhadi angahambelaniyo adweliswa aze ashiywe engatshintshwanga. Jonga kuqala ukuze ubone okuza kutshintsha.
scrum-import-preview-sprints: Ii-sprint: __created__ ezintsha, __matched__ esele zikule bhodi, __skipped__ ezingangeniswanga
scrum-import-preview-releases: Ukukhutshwa: __created__ okutsha, __matched__ okusele kukule bhodi, __skipped__ okungangeniswanga
scrum-import-preview-nothing: Akukho nto iza kutshintshwa: le bhodi sele inolu cwangciso.
scrum-import-into-board-done: Ucwangciso lwe-Scrum lungenisiwe lwaza lwarekhodwa kwiMbali.
scrum-import-card-ambiguous: Ikhadi lihambelana namakhadi angaphezu kwelinye kule bhodi: __reference__
scrum-import-card-on-another-board: Ikhadi lelenye ibhodi kwaye lishiywe lingatshintshwanga: __reference__
scrum-import-record-ambiguous: I-sprint okanye ukukhutshwa kuhambelana nokungaphezu kokunye kule bhodi: __reference__
scrum-import-record-not-imported: I-sprint, ukukhutshwa okanye isiganeko asikwazanga ukungeniswa: __reference__
sync-conflict-hint: Khetha ixabiso longquzulwano ngalunye. Ungqamaniso luzama kwakhona emva kokhetho ngalunye. Akukho nto ithunyelwa kwinkqubo yomthombo.
sync-conflict-refresh: Qhuba ungqamaniso kwakhona ukuze uhlole amaxabiso angoku.
sync-conflict-review-complete: Amakhadi owabelweyo ahloliwe. Akukho ngquzulwano lweenkalo luseleyo. Ungqamaniso loluhlu lonke aluqhutywanga.
sync-conflict-detach-hint: Susa kuphela unxulumaniso longqamaniso lwale kopi iphindiweyo. Umxholo wayo uhlala kwi-WeKan.
sync-conflict-archive-hint: Into yomthombo ayisekho, kodwa amakhadi angaphantsi asebenzayo athintela ukugcinwa kwindawo yogcino. Gcina eli khadi ekuhlaleni ngokususa unxulumaniso lwalo longqamaniso. Amakhadi angaphantsi awatshintshwa.
sync-conflict-creation: Yenza ikhadi longqamaniso eliza kungena endaweni yalo
sync-conflict-creation-hint: Gcina ikhadi langaphambili lingatshintshwanga uze wenze ikhadi elitsha longqamaniso kolu luhlu. Ukuzama kwakhona kusebenzisa elo khadi litsha.
sync-conflict-create-replacement: Yenza eliza kungena endaweni yalo apha
sync-preview-saved: Kusekelwe kwiisetingi ezigciniweyo. Ungqamaniso ngoku lulanda luze luhlole umthombo kwakhona.
sync-preview-unavailable: Gcina umthombo wongqamaniso ngaphambi kokucela ukujonga kuqala.
sync-preview-blocked: Sombulula ungquzulwano olungezantsi ngaphambi kokuhlola isicwangciso sotshintsho.
sync-preview-scope: Amanani abhekisa kwiinkalo zomthombo ezilungelelanisiweyo. Ezinye iinkcukacha zisenokushiywa sisihlalutyi somthombo.
sync-source-scope: Iindlela zidibanisa ukuvela kweenkalo kwizinto zomthombo. Izinto ezinganxulunyaniswanga zixelwa ziphelele; amaxabiso azo akaboniswa.
sync-source-converted: Iguqulelwe ekubeni ngumbhalo okanye enye indlela yokubonisa
sync-source-truncated: Ingxelo iphelela kwiindlela eziyi-100 namagama eenkalo afinyeziweyo.
sync-report-retention: Ungqamaniso lokugqibela oluyi-20. Iingxelo zigcinwa iintsuku ezingama-30.
sync-report-partial: Ungqamaniso olungaphumelelanga okanye olungagqitywanga lusenokuba lutshintshe amanye amakhadi. Ezi ngxelo aziqhubeki nongqamaniso okanye zirhoxise utshintsho lwalo.
sync-report-completed-with-warnings: Lugqityiwe kodwa kukho iinkalo ezishiyiweyo okanye eziguquliweyo
sync-report-unavailable: Iingxelo zongqamaniso zifuna imvume yokubhala kulo lonke uluhlu kunye neseva ekhoyo.
sync-recovery-description: Iingxelo zongqamaniso ezigciniweyo zeentsuku ezingama-30 ezidlulileyo. Khangela nge-ID yebhodi okanye yoluhlu. Isiphumo esingagqitywanga sisenokuthetha ukuba ungqamaniso lusaqhubeka okanye luphazamisekile. Hlaziya ukuze ujonge kwakhona; ezi ngxelo azikwazi ukuqhubeka nongqamaniso okanye ukurhoxisa utshintsho.
sync-recovery-unavailable: Akukwazeki ukufunda uxilongo longqamaniso. Jonga imvume yomlawuli nokufumaneka kweseva.
sync-estimate-field-hint: Khetha inkalo yamanani ene-ID yenkalo ye-Jira kunye neyunithi yoqikelelo, njengoko yenziwe kukungenisa kwe-Jira okunxulunyanisiweyo. Utshintsho lwasekuhlaleni luphononongwa njengongquzulwano. Amaxabiso angekhoyo emthonjeni awahoywa; ixabiso elingu-null ngokucacileyo licima ixabiso elinxulunyanisiweyo.
sync-estimate-field-gitlab-hint: Ubunzima okanye uqikelelo lwexesha lwe-GitLab lubhalwa kwindawo yamanani oyikhethayo. Utshintsho lwasekuhlaleni lujongwa njengeengxabano; umba ongenabunzima ucima ixabiso elidityanisiweyo.
email-recovery-description: Umgca omnye ngomamkeli ngamnye. Khangela nge-ID yomsebenzisi. Umxholo womyalezo namacandelo e-imeyile omamkeli awaboniswa. Ukunqumama kubamba imiyalezo ekhoyo nezayo; Ukuqhubeka kuzama kwakhona ukuthumela imiyalezo esemgceni ngoku. Ukurhoxisa kususa imiyalezo efakwe emgceni ukuya kwixesha lesicelo. Ukuba ukuthumela kuxakekile, zama kwakhona emva komzuzwana. Umyalezo osele uqalisile ukuthunyelwa awunakubuyiswa, kwaye ukuthumela okunesiphumo esingaqinisekanga kunokuphindwa. Ukusilela okusisigxina nemiyalezo efikelele kumda wokuzama kwakhona kuhlala kukhona ukuze kuhlolwe. Ukuzama kwakhona imiyalezo engaphumelelanga kuqalisa umjikelo omtsha wemizamo kwaye kugcina ukunqumama okukhoyo.
email-recovery-empty: Akukho miyalezo emgceni kwaye akukho bamkeli kunqunyanyiswe ukuthumela kubo.
email-recovery-unavailable: Akukwazeki ukufunda umgca wee-imeyile. Jonga amalungelo omlawuli nokufumaneka kweseva.
email-recovery-busy: Ukuthumela okanye omnye umsebenzi womgca uyaqhubeka. Hlaziya uze uzame kwakhona emva komzuzwana.
email-recovery-failed: Umsebenzi awukwazanga ukuqinisekiswa. Hlaziya umgca uze uzame kwakhona isenzo esifanayo ukuba kuyimfuneko.
email-recovery-superseded: Isenzo esitsha somsebenzisi olawulayo sithathe indawo yesi sicelo. Kuboniswa imeko yangoku yomgca.
email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Rhoxisa yonke imiyalezo esemgceni ngoku yalo mamkeli? Umxholo wayo uza kucinywa kwaye awunakubuyiselwa. Imiyalezo emitsha eyenziwe emva kwesi sicelo iya kugcinwa.
email-failure-delivery-unconfirmed: Ukuhanjiswa akukwazanga ukuqinisekiswa; phonononga phambi kokuzama kwakhona
sync-time-estimate-hint: Uqikelelo lwexesha lusebenzisa iinkalo zamanani zexesha lokuqala/eliseleyo ezenziwe kukungenisa kwe-Jira. Kufuneka kubekho inkalo enye kuphela ehambelanayo kule bhodi. Utshintsho lwasekuhlaleni luphononongwa njengongquzulwano; amaxabiso angekhoyo emthonjeni awahoywa kwaye ixabiso elingu-null ngokucacileyo licima ixabiso.
sync-planning-hint: I-sprint nokukhutshwa zingqamaniswa kuphela xa i-Scrum ivuliwe kule bhodi. I-sprint okanye ukukhutshwa okungekhoyo kwenziwa kule bhodi, ngemihla enikwa ngumthombo; okukhoyo kuthelekiswa kuqala nge-ID yomthombo, kuze emva koko kuthelekiswe ngegama. Utshintsho locwangciso lwasekuhlaleni luhlala de umthombo utshintshe ucwangciso lwaloo ngxaki, kwaye ungqamaniso lokuqala aluze lususe ucwangciso.
activity-recovery-description: Izaziso ezingagqitywanga zizanywa kwakhona ngokuzenzekelayo. Phonononga imisebenzi engekhoyo okanye etshintshiweyo ngaphambi kokuzama kwakhona. Ukuzama kwakhona akuze kudale umsebenzi kwakhona.
activity-recovery-busy: Enye inkqubo isingatha esi saziso. Hlaziya uze uzame kwakhona.
activity-recovery-denied: Imvume yomamkeli okanye ukhetho lwezaziso alusakuvumeli ukuhanjiswa.
activity-recovery-source-unavailable: Umsebenzi wokuqala awukho okanye utshintshile. Akukho nto idalwe kwakhona.
activity-recovery-failed: Akukwazekanga ukugqiba ukuhanjiswa kwezaziso. Umsebenzi osalindileyo ugciniwe.
activity-recovery-control-conflict: Esi saziso sitshintshile ukususela ekulayishweni kwaso. Phonononga imeko ehlaziyiweyo ngaphambi kokuzama kwakhona.
activity-recovery-control-failed: Akukwazekanga ukuqinisekisa isetingi yokuhanjiswa. Hlaziya uze uphonononge imeko yayo yangoku.
activity-recovery-cancel-confirm: Urhoxisa ngokusisigxina ukuhanjiswa okuseleyo kwalo msebenzi? Oku akunakuphinda kuqhutyekwe nako. Imeyile esele ibekwe emgceni nezaziso esele zihanjisiwe azibuyiswa.
rule-email-recovery-description: Hlola iinzame ezirekhodiweyo zokuthumela ii-imeyile zemithetho. Iinzame ezingaqinisekiswanga kusenokwenzeka ukuba zisathumela okanye ziphazamisekile. Le ngxelo ayiphindi ithumele kwaye ayikurhoxisi ukuthumela.
rule-email-recovery-empty: Akukho zinzame zokuthumela ii-imeyile zemithetho ezihambelana nolu phendlo.
rule-email-recovery-unavailable: Akukwazekanga ukulayisha amalinge emeyile yemithetho. Hlaziya ukuze uzame kwakhona.
rule-email-recovery-actions-hint: I-WeKan ayiphindi ithumele i-imeyile engaqinisekiswanga ngokwayo. Ukuthumela kwakhona kuya kuphela kubamkeli abangaqinisekiswanga. Yiphawule njengethunyiweyo ukuba uyazi ukuba ifikile, okanye urhoxise ukuthumela.
rule-email-recovery-wait: Ukuthumela kokuqala kusenokuba kusaqhubeka. Ungagqiba emva kwe-__time__.
rule-email-recovery-resend-confirm: Thumela le imeyile kwakhona kubamkeli abangaqinisekiswanga? Nabani na oneseva yemeyile eyamkele umyalezo ingazisanga i-WeKan uya kuwufumana kabini.
rule-email-recovery-mark-sent-confirm: Phawula le imeyile njengethunyiweyo kubo bonke? Yenza oku kuphela ukuba uyazi ukuba ifikile.
rule-email-recovery-drop-confirm: Rhoxisa ukuthumela le imeyile? Ayizukuthunyelwa kubamkeli abangaqinisekiswanga.
rule-email-resolution-too-early: Ukuthumela kokuqala kusenokuba kusaqhubeka. Zama kwakhona kamva.
rule-email-resolution-resend-in-flight: Ukuthumela kwakhona kwangaphambili kusenokuba kusaqhubeka. Zama kwakhona kamva.
rule-email-resolution-nothing-to-resend: Bonke abamkeli sele beqinisekisiwe. Endaweni yoko, yiphawule njengethunyiweyo.
rule-email-resolution-resend-uncertain: Iseva yemeyile ayiphendulanga. Umyalezo othunyelwe kwakhona usenokuba ufikile okanye awufikanga; uboniswa njengoqhubekayo.
rule-email-resolution-busy: Omnye umlawuli usombulula le imeyile. Zama kwakhona kungekudala.
rule-email-resolution-command-changed: I-imeyile egciniweyo ayisahambelani neli linge, ngoko ayinakusonjululwa apha.
rule-email-resolution-attempt-invalid: Ingxelo egciniweyo yeli linge ayisebenzi, ngoko alinakusonjululwa apha.
rule-email-resolution-failed: Le imeyile ayikwazanga ukusonjululwa. Hlaziya iphepha uze uzame kwakhona.
rule-email-legacy-description: Ezi imeyile zemithetho zalungiswa yinguqulelo yangaphambili ye-WeKan engazange ibhale apho umxholo wazo uvela khona, ngoko i-WeKan ayizukuzithumela ngokwayo. Emva kokujonga ukuba umbhali womthetho usenelungelo lokufikelela, qhagamshela i-imeyile kwakhona ukuze ilungiswe ngokwemeko yangoku yekhadi, okanye uyilahle.
rule-email-legacy-rebind-confirm: Lungisa le imeyile kwakhona ngokwemeko yangoku yekhadi? Umxholo wayo usenokwahluka kulowo walungiswa ngaphambili.
rule-email-legacy-discard-confirm: Lahla le imeyile? Ayisayi kuze ithunyelwe.
rule-email-legacy-unavailable: Akukwazanga ukulayishwa ii-imeyile zemithetho ezilindele ukuhlolwa. Hlaziya iphepha ukuze uzame kwakhona.
rule-email-legacy-access-denied: Umbhali womthetho akasenalo ilungelo lokufikelela kweli khadi, okanye umthetho utshintshile, ngoko i-imeyile ayinakuqhagamshelwa kwakhona. Ungayilahla.
rule-email-legacy-source-changed: Umsebenzi obangele le imeyile utshintshile, ngoko ayinakuqhagamshelwa kwakhona. Ungayilahla.
rule-email-legacy-source-unavailable: Ikhadi evela kulo le imeyile alisafumaneki, ngoko ayinakuqhagamshelwa kwakhona. Ungayilahla.
rule-email-legacy-plan-unavailable: Ukuqhutywa komthetho okulungise le imeyile akusagcinwanga, ngoko ayinakuqhagamshelwa kwakhona. Ungayilahla.
rule-email-legacy-attempt-exists: Le imeyile sele ithunyelwe, kuzanyiwe ukuyithumela, okanye ilahliwe.
rule-email-legacy-failed: Esi senzo asikwazanga ukugqitywa. Hlaziya iphepha uze uzame kwakhona.
stuck-sync-operation-description: Nganye kwezi nkqubo zongqamaniso loluhlu ezigciniweyo yema ingekagqitywa kwaye ayisakwazi ukugqitywa, kuba uluhlu lwasuswa, lwadalwa kwakhona okanye lwaqwalaselwa ngokutsha, okanye umsebenzisi owayiqalayo waphulukana nemvume yokubhala. Xa enye isalindile, olo luhlu alunakungqamaniswa. Yilahle ukuze uluhlu lukwazi ukungqamaniswa kwakhona: utshintsho esele lwenziwe luyahlala, utshintsho oluseleyo olugciniweyo aluze lubhalwe, kwaye ungqamaniso olulandelayo luthelekisa uluhlu nomthombo walo kwakhona.
stuck-sync-operation-reason-scope-change: Uluhlu lwasuswa, lwadalwa kwakhona okanye iisetingi zalo zongqamaniso zatshintsha
stuck-sync-operation-reason-access-denie: Umsebenzisi owaqalayo akasenayo imvume yokubhala kulo lonke uluhlu
stuck-sync-operation-reason-trigger-unkn: Igcinwe luhlobo lwangaphambili lwe-WeKan ngaphandle kokuba yintoni eyayiqalayo
stuck-sync-operation-replayable-now: Ingaphinda iqhutywe ngoku kwaye iya kuzigqiba ngokwayo, ngoko ayinakulahlwa.
stuck-sync-operation-discard-confirm: Ulahla le nkqubo yongqamaniso loluhlu igciniweyo? Utshintsho esele ilwenzile luyahlala; oluseleyo aluze lubhalwe. Uluhlu lunokungqamaniswa kwakhona emva koko.
stuck-sync-operation-empty: Akukho nkqubo zongqamaniso loluhlu zilindele uphononongo.
stuck-sync-operation-truncated: Kuboniswa kuphela ezona zindala ziyi-50. Lahla ezinye uze uhlaziye ukuze ubone ezinye.
stuck-sync-operation-unavailable: Akukwazekanga ukulayisha iinkqubo zongqamaniso loluhlu. Hlaziya ukuze uzame kwakhona.
stuck-sync-operation-not-stuck: Le nkqubo ayifunyaniswanga ixingile, ngoko ayinakulahlwa.
stuck-sync-operation-replayable: Le nkqubo ingaphinda iqhutywe ngoku kwaye iya kuzigqiba ngokwayo, ngoko ayilahlwanga.
stuck-sync-operation-busy: Olu luhlu luyangqamaniswa ngoku. Zama kwakhona emva komzuzwana.
stuck-sync-operation-failed: Akukwazekanga ukugqiba esi senzo. Hlaziya uze uzame kwakhona.
interrupted-import-description: Nganye kwezi nkqubo zokungenisa ibhodi yema ingekagqitywa — iseva yaqala ngokutsha okanye ukungenisa akuphumelelanga — yaza yashiya ibhodi engaphelelanga. Ukungenisa akunakuqhubeka, kuba ifayile yomthombo ayigcinwa. Gcina ibhodi injengoko injalo, okanye uyilahle uze ungenise ifayile kwakhona. Ukulahla kususa ibhodi eyenziwe koku kungenisa nayo yonke into ekuyo, kuquka nantoni na eyongezwe kuyo ukususela ngoko.
interrupted-import-scrum: Inqanaba layo le-Scrum linendawo yalo yokugcina inkqubela (__state__, inyathelo __next__ kwangama-__total__). Ukuba ugcina ibhodi, ligqibe okanye ulilahle kwindawo yokubuyisela ukungenisa kwe-Scrum yebhodi.
interrupted-import-counts: Iindlela zokuqubha eziyi-__swimlanes__, izintlu eziyi-__lists__, amakhadi ayi-__cards__, izintlu zokuhlola eziyi-__checklists__, izimvo eziyi-__comments__, izincamathelisi eziyi-__attachments__
interrupted-import-keep-confirm: Ugcina le bhodi ingaphelelanga injengoko injalo? Akukho nto isuswayo, kwaye ukungenisa akusadweliswa apha.
interrupted-import-discard-confirm: Ulahla oku kungenisa? Ibhodi eyenziweyo nayo yonke into ekuyo isuswa ngokusisigxina.
interrupted-import-empty: Akukho kungeniswa kweebhodi kuphazamisekileyo kulindele uphononongo.
interrupted-import-truncated: Kuboniswa kuphela ezona zindala ziyi-50. Gcina okanye ulahle ezinye uze uhlaziye ukuze ubone ezinye.
interrupted-import-unavailable: Akukwazekanga ukulayisha ukungeniswa kweebhodi okuphazamisekileyo. Hlaziya ukuze uzame kwakhona.
interrupted-import-foreign-board: Ibhodi enale ID ayenziwanga koku kungenisa, ngoko ayichukunyiswanga.
interrupted-import-scrum-busy: Inqanaba layo le-Scrum lisabhalwa okanye lisabuyiselwa. Zama kwakhona emva kwemizuzu embalwa.
interrupted-import-failed: Akukwazekanga ukugqiba esi senzo. Hlaziya uze uzame kwakhona.
saml-login-not-started: Oku kungena nge-SAML akuqalwanga kule thebhu yesikhangeli. Nceda ungene kwakhona.
history-request-pending-undo: Iseva ayikaqinisekisi ukuhlehlisa kwakho utshintsho lokugqibela.
history-request-pending-redo: Iseva ayikaqinisekisi ukuphinda wenze utshintsho lwakho lokugqibela.
history-request-hint: Ukuzama kwakhona kuphinda isicelo esinye, ngoko akunakuze kuhlehlise utshintsho lwesibini.
scrum-history-checkpoint-stuck: Ukuhlehlisa, ukuphinda okanye ukubuyisela utshintsho lwe-Scrum kume ngenxa yongquzulwano. Ukuhlela i-Scrum kule bhodi kuthintelwe de lusonjululwe.
scrum-history-checkpoint-counts: Utshintsho oluyi-__applied__ koluyi-__total__ lubhaliwe, oluyi-__pending__ alubhalwanga, kwaye oluyi-__conflicted__ lutshintshwe ngomnye umntu ukususela ngoko.
scrum-history-checkpoint-hint: Ukubuyisela kubeka ingxelo nganye etshintshiweyo kwimeko yayo yangaphambili; kufumaneka kuphela xa kungekho mntu wumbi utshintshe ezo ngxelo ukususela ngoko.
